title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
报名很简单，只需要填写信息，然后上交1000块联盟币保证金便可以了。这1000块钱，是为了保证训练家，能够准时到场。毕竟已经为你排了比赛，如果到时候太多人缺赛的话，就会导致场面太过于尴尬。可交了钱就不一样了，交了钱就会潜意识的把这件事记住。当然，在比赛完后，举办方会把这笔钱退回去。报完名，差不多已经是上午十点了，林枫想了想，还打算购买一些东西回去，轻车熟路的，走到超市里面的树果区，将保养能量方块的材料买好，林枫看向怀中的藤藤蛇，“你有需要要买的东西吗？”“藤藤？”藤藤蛇摇了摇头，它只在树林边缘偷偷观摩过人类。如这样的超市，它还从来没有见过。不过它心中偷偷记下了，用那个小方块一样的机器（手机）便能换取很多东西。“要不要再买一只洛托姆？”林枫陷入了沉思，对于道馆或者培育屋来说，洛托姆绝对是最佳帮手，不管是信息记录，还是天气预报，土壤的湿度，这些洛托姆都可以做到。也是唯一不占据训练家宝可梦名额的宝可梦。不过这个念头也只是在他脑海中一闪而过，最后化为一句，“算了，等有钱了再买。”父母留给他的钱已经不多了。他昨天看了看，还剩32万左右，而一只洛托姆，需要25万。总得留一些钱拿来应急，更何况现在种植园的面积也不大，他一个人也能管的过来。买好这些后，林枫在回去的路上，又看到一些牧草种子，思索了一下，与其让其他的土地又长满杂草，不如种植一些牧草。他记得，在梧桐市附属下的花桥村，有人开辟了一个大奶罐养殖场，有时候会在外面收一些干牧草。就算不收，到时候，他也可以自己种，想养一些能产奶的大奶罐的想法早就扎根在他的脑海中了。作为一个合格的培育屋，宝可梦肯定不能太单一。要知道，一些得到联盟认可的培育屋，能养着几十种宝可梦，甚至还能成为新人训练家的第一站，供其挑选御三家。不过到时候肯定很忙。这样想想，似乎当一名培育家好像有种上班族的感觉了。

（悲～）弄好这些后，林枫直接带着藤藤蛇去吃了一顿牛排，不过却遭到后者评价，“藤藤，”（好像还没有你做的面好吃....）这让林枫笑了起来。开什么玩笑，自己可是神级培育家呀！相对于前世，这个世界上，由于宝可梦的强大力量，小部分普通动物已经灭亡，其余的普通动物，也只能在人类的保护下，才能繁殖生存下去。回到家，林枫做的第一件事，便是给丑丑鱼制造保养能量方块。这已经是轻车熟路的操作了，不过十来分钟，新鲜的能量方块就出炉了。【保养能量方块：c级能量方块，用美容果和祛斑草制造而成的能量方块，长期服用，能够保持皮肤（鳞片）光滑亮丽。料理效果：融合了美容果和去斑草效用的能量方块，将这两种秘物的效果发挥到了极致，吃下后，魅力1h内增加15%。】“嗯？”林枫发出了一道惊疑声。魅力这种属性怎么看？他吃了之后会有效果吗？将热乎乎的能量方块，捏碎放到鱼缸中，看着丑丑鱼欢快的吃下这些能量方块。伴随着一种莫名的变化。林枫揉了揉眼睛，他感觉眼前的丑丑鱼，似乎真的变好看了一点？鳞片更光滑了，逐渐由黑灰色，向着乳白色转变，鱼目也变得精致了一点。这个变化还是挺大的。“效果这么好？”“藤藤蛇，你要吃吗？”林枫又将能量方块放在藤藤蛇面前，后者欣然接过。它吃了之后，变化倒没这么显着了，只是看起来更光滑了一点。“这样子看起来，大概三四天就能让你进化了。”等过了一段时间，林枫将丑丑鱼从鱼缸中抱出来。看着之前坑坑洼洼的地方，现在已经慢慢的变好，满意的说道。有了美纳斯，他就可以.....嘿嘿嘿....就可以偷懒了呀～
content_en:
Registration is very simple, you only need to fill in the information and then hand in a deposit of 1,000 alliance coins.This 1,000 yuan is to ensure that the trainer can arrive on time.After all, the game has been arranged for you. If too many people are absent from the game, the scene will be too embarrassing.But it's different after you pay the money. After you pay the money, you will subconsciously remember it.Of course, the organizer will refund the money after the game.After signing up, it was almost ten o'clock in the morning. Lin Feng thought about it and planned to buy some things to go back. He walked to the fruit section of the supermarket and bought the materials for maintaining the energy cube. Lin Feng looked at the Vine Snake in his arms, "Do you have anything you need to buy?" "Vine?" The Vine Snake shook its head. It had only secretly observed humans at the edge of the forest.I have never seen a supermarket like this before.However, it secretly remembered that using that small box-like machine (mobile phone) can exchange for a lot of things."Do you want to buy another Rotom?" Lin Feng fell into deep thought. Rotom is definitely the best helper for a gym or a breeding house. Whether it is information recording, weather forecast, or soil moisture, Rotom can do everything.It is also the only Pokémon that does not occupy the Trainer Pokémon quota.However, this thought only flashed through his mind, and finally turned into a sentence, "Forget it, I will buy it when I have money." The money left by his parents was not much.He looked at it yesterday and found that there were about 320,000 left, and a Rotom cost 250,000.There must be some money left for emergencies, not to mention that the area of ​​the plantation is not large now, and he can manage it by himself.After buying these, Lin Feng saw some grass seeds on the way back and thought about it. Instead of letting other land become overgrown with weeds, it would be better to plant some grass.He remembered that in Huaqiao Village, which is affiliated to Wutong City, someone opened a large milk tank breeding farm, and sometimes collected some dry grass outside.Even if he doesn't harvest, he can grow his own when the time comes. The idea of ​​raising some large milk tanks that can produce milk has long been rooted in his mind.As a qualified breeding house, Pokémon must not be too single.You know, some training houses approved by the alliance can raise dozens of Pokémon, and can even become the first stop for new trainers to choose from.But it will definitely be very busy then.Thinking about it this way, it seems that being a cultivator feels like an office worker.

(Sad~) After doing this, Lin Feng took Teng Teng Snake directly to have a steak, but the latter commented, "Teng Teng," (it seems not as delicious as the noodles you made...) This made Lin Feng laugh.Are you kidding me? I am a god-level breeder!Compared with the previous life, in this world, due to the powerful power of Pokémon, a small number of ordinary animals have perished, and the remaining ordinary animals can only reproduce and survive under the protection of humans.When he got home, the first thing Lin Feng did was to make maintenance energy cubes for Chou Chou Fish.This was already a familiar operation, but within ten minutes, fresh energy cubes were produced.[Maintenance Energy Cube: C-level energy cube, made from beauty fruit and freckle grass. Long-term use can keep the skin (scales) smooth and bright.Cooking effect: The energy cube combines the effects of beauty fruit and freckle remover, bringing the effects of these two secret substances to the extreme. After eating, the charm will increase by 15% within 1 hour.] "Huh?" Lin Feng made a sound of surprise.What do you think of the attribute charm?Will it have any effect after he takes it?Crush the hot energy cubes and put them into the fish tank, and watch the ugly fish eat these energy cubes happily.Accompanied by an inexplicable change.Lin Feng rubbed his eyes. He felt that the ugly fish in front of him really seemed to look better?The scales are smoother, gradually changing from black gray to milky white, and the fish eyes have become a little more refined.This change is quite big."The effect is so good?" "Vine Snake, do you want to eat it?" Lin Feng placed the energy cube in front of Vine Snake again, and the latter took it happily.After eating it, the change was not so obvious, it just looked a little smoother."It looks like you'll be able to evolve in about three or four days." After waiting for a while, Lin Feng took the ugly fish out of the fish tank.Looking at the previously bumpy areas, they are now slowly getting better, and he said with satisfaction.With Menas, he can...hehehe...he can be lazy~
